fields.Name: C1 -> S2.2
fields.Description: Gate G1.2 (phase 1, dataset C1, criterion S2.2): training the C1 renewal pipeline through its Prediction Unit excludes the 1,756 person-years whose outcome window ends after the corpus end, and the training run stores censoredRowsExcluded = 1,756 with resolvedRows = 4,873. It fails when the unit row reader skips the exclude-unresolved censoring step, so the stored excluded count is 0, not 1,756.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The training run stores censoredRowsExcluded = 1,756 and resolvedRows = 4,873.
